ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left side of the figure is a phylogenetic tree, with the five insects O, P, Q, R, S labeled at the tips, and the internal positions labeled I, II, III, IV. O and P converge near position I; Q and R converge near position IV; these branches are then connected with more basal branches. S is located on a separate terminal branch at the very bottom, and the common connection point of S and the remaining O, P, Q, R is located at position III. On the right side is a table of the number of differences between species, but judging the common ancestor of the five insects is mainly based on the phylogenetic tree on the left. Then reason: to find the oldest common ancestor of these 5 insects, it is necessary to trace back from the five tips O, P, Q, R, S along the branches toward the base of the tree. The common ancestor of O and P includes only O and P; the common ancestor of Q and R includes only Q and R; the area near position II includes the common branch of O, P, Q, R, but does not include S. Continuing to trace back to a more basal position, the branch of S and the branches of the other four insects converge at position III, therefore the oldest common ancestor that includes all five insects is located at Position III.

planner_metadata.image_role: 从左侧树图读取末端昆虫/类群标记 O、P、Q、R、S，以及内部位置 I、II、III、IV：I 连接 O 和 P，IV 连接 Q 和 R，II 连接 I 与 IV 所代表的四个类群，而 III 是连接 S 与其余四个类群共同分支的更基部节点。
planner_metadata.text_role: 读取题干要求：“这5种昆虫最古老的共同祖先位于哪个位置”，明确目标是在图中 I、II、III、IV 等位置中选出包含五个昆虫的共同祖先位置。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 系统发育树中，多个末端类群的共同祖先位于这些类群所有路径首次汇合的内部节点；若问“最古老的共同祖先”，应选择包含全部五个末端类群的最基部共同节点。
